explication: Uzu is a cross-platform local AI inference engine, exposed through Rust and language bindings and used by Mirai’s desktop GUI, CLI, and examples. The primary workflow is to initialize the engine, find and download a model, create a chat session, and generate a reply. The README also highlights unified model configuration, traceable computation, Apple unified memory, and broad model support. The GUI and several internal engine and legacy modules are visible in the tree or SOURCE INDEX, but their detailed runtime wiring was not sampled; those connections are left unasserted.
